articles.title: Here's what SpaceX's IPO means for its $1.3 billion bitcoin reserve
articles.snippet: The largest company on public markets now holds bitcoin as a treasury reserve, not as a business model. Its first earnings cycles will test which version of corporate crypto survives a bear market.

articles.title: Anthropic's pre-IPO shares fall as U.S. government shuts down its most powerful AI model
articles.snippet: A jailbreak report prompted Washington to pull Fable 5 and Mythos 5 from all users. Anthropic complied but pushed back hard, saying the finding sets a standard that would halt the entire AI industry.

articles.title: The U.S. government is betting $2 Billion on quantum computing, and the defense side can't keep up
articles.snippet: Pruden argues that to defend against a quantum computer capable of cryptographically relevant operations, we need post-quantum cryptography and regulatory coordination that the industry has been deferring for years.

articles.title: Bitcoin sales are necessary for Strategy's digital credit business, Saylor says
articles.snippet: Strategy's recent Bitcoin sale appeared to clash with Saylor's "never sell" mantra, but he says the move reflects how the company's digital credit business works.

articles.title: Major crypto exchanges cancel SpaceX IPO allocations, promising refunds
articles.snippet: Elon Musk’s SpaceX completed its landmark IPO on the Nasdaq on Friday, but crypto users seeking tokenized exposure to the IPO were left empty-handed after allocations fell through.
